visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The screen is split into four distinct quadrants. Top-left shows a round black grill pan with several slices of raw, marbled red beef and a single white onion slice sizzling. Top-right shows a man with short dark hair wearing a blue and white striped polo shirt, eating white rice from a metal bowl. Bottom-left features the man talking directly to the camera, and bottom-right displays a platter of high-quality raw beef with king oyster mushrooms. (2) The scene shifts to a full-frame close-up of beef pieces on the iron grill. Steam rises as the meat turns from red to brown. A person's hand, partially visible, uses metal tongs to flip a piece of meat. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the texture of the fat and muscle. (3) An exterior shot shows the restaurant entrance. A large green sign features Korean characters in white and red, with the text '고바우' and 'Since 1984' clearly visible. The building looks aged and traditional, located in a narrow urban street. (4) Back inside, a close-up shows a white printed menu with photos of various beef cuts and prices listed in Korean Won. Hand-held camera movement pans down the list. (5) A platter of raw beef is shown with yellow text overlays identifying the cuts: '牛里脊' (Sirloin), '橫隔膜' (Hanging Tender), and '排骨肉' (Rib Meat). The meat is vibrant red with intricate white marbling. (6) A steaming pot of soybean paste soup (doenjang-jjigae) is served on the table. It is surrounded by small white dishes containing side items like raw garlic, kimchi, and a dark fermented dipping sauce. The man uses a spoon to scoop the broth and tofu over his rice bowl. (7) The man is shown eating a piece of cooked meat dipped in a small dish of salt. His eyes widen in a look of extreme satisfaction and he blows a kiss to the camera. He wears a black digital watch on his left wrist. (8) A sequence shows the assembly of a lettuce wrap. A large green lettuce leaf is held in one hand, and metal chopsticks place a piece of beef and some seasoned beansprouts inside. (9) The man stuffs the large lettuce wrap into his mouth. He chews with his mouth full, displaying a 'thumbs up' gesture with his right hand. Yellow 'Variety' style text overlays appear around his face. (10) The final scene shows the restaurant's internal preparation area with various stainless steel containers filled with side dishes. A server wearing a black mask and a black uniform with an apron carries a tray toward the customers. A map overlay appears at the bottom with address and hours.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male narration begins over an upbeat acoustic guitar-driven pop track at approximately 112 BPM. The speaker has a friendly, high-arousal delivery style with clear enunciation. (2) A distinct, sharp sizzling sound of fat rendering on a hot grill pan is introduced, layered over the speech and music. (3) The rhythmic sound of metal tongs tapping against an iron surface triggers a new phase. Narration continues describing the quality of the beef. (4) A low-frequency bubbling and steaming sound accompanies the presentation of the soybean paste soup. The background music maintains a consistent, joyful beat. (5) A sharp clinking sound of metal chopsticks hitting a stainless steel bowl is heard. The speaker's voice becomes more animated and high-pitched, expressing extreme pleasure. (6) The narrator exclaims 'Mashi-soyo' in Korean with a dramatic rising intonation. Faint background restaurant chatter and laughing sounds become more noticeable during this peak of excitement. (7) The final phase features a quick 'pop' sound effect as the man gives a thumbs up. The narration concludes with a fast-paced summary of price and location information before the music fades out.

By combining close-up visual evidence of high-marbled Hanwoo beef with enthusiastic vocal reactions and clear logistical details, it aims to persuade viewers to visit this specific location for its quality service and affordable price.
